title: Qodo Unleashes AI to Tame Code Chaos Across Multi-Repository Dev Environments
summary: Qodo has significantly expanded its AI-powered code review platform, now enabling its intelligent agent to scrutinize code across multiple repositories simultaneously. This update, version 2.8, also introduces a custom rules miner, promising to elevate code quality and governance for modern development teams.
content:
The sprawling landscape of modern software development is a double-edged sword: agility through distributed teams and microservices often comes with the headache of maintaining consistent code quality and governance across a multitude of repositories. For far too long, developers have grappled with the fragmented oversight that hampers efficiency and introduces vulnerabilities.

Enter Qodo, a player increasingly making waves in the DevOps space, which this week unveiled a significant leap forward in tackling this very challenge. Its platform for managing code quality just got a substantial upgrade, empowering its artificial intelligence (AI) agent to cast its discerning eye over code that spans not just one, but multiple repositories concurrently. This isn't just a minor tweak; it's a fundamental shift in how large-scale projects can ensure uniformity and adherence to standards without the manual burden that often bogs down development cycles.

This enhanced reach, arriving with version 2.8 of the Qodo platform, is complemented by another powerful addition: a custom rules miner. Imagine an AI that not only applies existing best practices but actively learns and discovers *new* patterns and potential pitfalls within your codebase, suggesting governance rules tailored specifically to your project's evolving nature. This intelligent detective work promises to move beyond reactive error catching, allowing teams to proactively bake in quality and security from the outset, adapting to the unique intricacies of their software architecture.

For organizations battling technical debt and striving for agile delivery, Qodo's latest iteration represents a compelling proposition. By centralizing AI-driven analysis across disparate codebases, it offers a unified front against inconsistency and potential issues, freeing up precious developer time. It underscores a growing trend where AI isn't just assisting, but actively reshaping the foundational practices of software engineering, paving the way for more robust, secure, and maintainable applications at scale.
keyTakeaways: Qodo's platform now enables AI agents to review code across multiple repositories simultaneously.
Version 2.8 introduces a custom rules miner for discovering new, project-specific governance rules and best practices.
The updates aim to enhance code quality, consistency, and developer efficiency in complex, multi-repository environments.
author: Mike Vizard
